nom: Cetaphil Healthy Renew Purified Peptides Night Cream

avis.texte: The cream is moisturizing, but the scent is difficult to tolerate. I have to breathe through my mouth when applying the cream. I will not purchase it again.
Loved it! I've had a past of dry skin, so i bought this to use at night. so far it's been amazing and one little tube can last for so long! if you're looking for a new pm moisturizer, try this

I recently had a bad skin reaction from my previous skincare and needed a thick mouisturizer to mask the itchiness i was experiencing. This lotion has done the trick and I love it! Keeps my skin moisturized and helps my skin texture a ton. There is a smell but once you put it on you cant smell it anymore. Thanks Cetaphil for not putting any unneccesary fragrances in this!

The creme has a very nice texture for my mature always dry skin. I have both the serum of this line and the full jar of moisturizer and have not gotten used to the scent of what I associate with an upset stomach on my face. If only you had been able to make this line without any odor. I thought perhaps I had purchased a jar that had spoiled but in reading the other reviews, this is not just me. If it performed a miracle on my old skin perhaps I would tolerate the odor but I see no reason to put myself through this for no visible signs of correction.

avis.titre: Amazing night moisturizer for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I am one of the many who has reactions to cosmetic grade retinol products, mostly dermatitis even after one use. I also am very fair and redness shows very easily on my skin, so I don't want harsh active anti-aging products because they cause redness for me. I have used other creams with peptides in them before and tolerated that well, and as a user of Cetaphil products, I was very happy when this came out. I do see many reviews about a smell, but I don't experience this. It doesn't have fragrance, but the smell of the product disappears on me when it is applied. I also have PCOS and can get acne easily, but my skin is very well moisturized and balanced with this cream without breakouts. I also don't wake up with dry feeling skin.
If you want to got to bed with the smell of barf on your face, this is the cream for you. I can't believe it has good reviews.
I have older, less oily skin. This moisturizer helps greatly with dryness. I was disappointed to receive a half way full filled unopened container.
They really need to figure out how to make this smell better. Im not easily bothered by smells but this is off putting!
This smells like v@mit. I can't get past it. It could be the most amazing moisturizer on earth and I still wouldn't use it because of the smell.
Over all, its a great hydrating product. a little goes a long way. Deep hydration. Regarding the smell...it smells like cheetos to me. smell fades quickly.
I like the product but it has a bad smell. I would like to know why it smells this way. I have used other Cetaphil products and they didn't smell bad.😕

i like the way this product works HOWEVER the combination of ingredients that lacks fragrance equates to a smell that is reminiscent of cheddar and sour cream potato chips which is truthfully not the way i want my face to smell as my head hits the pillow. i'm sensitive to smell so this is unfortunately a dealbreaker

I agree with a review that said it smelled like vomit when applied. I agree! it stinks - I liked the product but I stopped using it because I couldn't stand the smell. My husband said it smelled like stinky feet. It's too bad because otherwise it's fine.

avis.titre: Looking for something new for older skin
avis.texte: I like to stay with items under this name of Cetaphil for my Rosacea. Will be giving it a try soon

When I first opened the jar, I didn't smell much. The next morning, I was pleased with how well it moisturized my face. BUT, after 4 or 5 days, it began to smell unbelievably bad. Hydrates well if you don't mind smelling like sweaty socks. I'm so disappointed. I've used Cetaphil products for many years. 😔

I've used this a few times now and it seems to be a nice night cream. Lightweight and not too greasy. Only thing I truly dislike about it is the smell. It actually stinks pretty bad and the reason I won't be repurchasing.

The product works well and after a couple of weeks Ive seen that my skin looks more moisturized, makes my skin look brighter, and you get a good amount of product for the price. Im not a fan of the smell at all. I cant pinpoint it but it smells somewhere between artificial cheddar popcorn and wet dog. With other options within this price range, I'll probably switch to something else soon.

avis.titre: Not a single peptide in the product
avis.texte: Dear Cetaphil - please do not advertise peptides in the label if your product contains no peptides. Else, indicate which of your ingredients are peptides. Currently, I don't see any!

This is so moisturizing and softening. The redness I've been dealing with for years is almost gone and its only been a month. Yeah, it has a slight foot smell, but its gone in an instant and the results are worth it!

Yes, this smells like parmesan cheese but the scent dissipates once its applied so I would still repurchase! I have very dry (often flaky) and sensitive skin and this works so well to keep my face moisturized and soft, without irritation.

I would not change a thing about this cream and plan to buy it for as long as they keep making it. :)
